industry.why: Neutral, carried, balanced on new evidence both ways. Component 1 regime, 23-Oct-26 (risk-off confirmed and broadening: the discount-rate squeeze now a positioning wash-out in the artificial intelligence complex with credit leading it, bonds rallied as a hedge for the first time this cycle while the Fed still hikes in December, the US 10-year near 5.10%, Brent $111, French sovereign stress spilling into Italy, European defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows and breadth in the bottom fifth of three years; sources present 2026-W43): two houses call a cyclical upturn, DNB Carnegie (22 Oct) reading Sandvik and Metso as a new mining cycle and Danske (18 Oct) heavy trucks and pulp and paper turning, and Goldman's economists (16 Oct) have US industrial production beating with machinery and electrical equipment near peak capacity use; against it, Danske's own warning that most cyclical exposure is 'more or less at all-time highs' with 'cost inflation emerging', a risk-off regime confirmed on all five defensive windows, and Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-10-23 against 2026-08-21, not week on week: D now, C prior at industry level. The sector rows do the work: Electrical equipment and grid, Diversified groups, Distributors and Test and measurement at C, Flow control and Building technology at D. Counter-case for B: the order data are the strongest non-AI demand read in the pack; for D: the tape and the regime.

sector.why: Neutral, carried. Component 1 regime, 23-Oct-26 (risk-off confirmed and broadening: the discount-rate squeeze now a positioning wash-out in the artificial intelligence complex with credit leading it, bonds rallied as a hedge for the first time this cycle while the Fed still hikes in December, the US 10-year near 5.10%, Brent $111, French sovereign stress spilling into Italy, European defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows and breadth in the bottom fifth of three years; sources present 2026-W43): Danske (18 Oct) sees heavy trucks 'in the early phase of a new cyclical upturn' on two months of rising US freight shipments, truckload rates up 10% and fleet age above seven years, the first demand read on this group; but the two Pool names here, CAF and Stadler Rail, are rail makers selling into government-funded programmes, which the trucking read does not touch, and Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-10-23 against 2026-08-21, not week on week: D now, C prior. Balanced; Neutral by judgement. Moves to B on a European truck-order reading or if relative strength returns to B.

geography.why: Overweight, carried unchanged. Component 1 regime, 23-Oct-26 (risk-off confirmed and broadening: the discount-rate squeeze now a positioning wash-out in the artificial intelligence complex with credit leading it, bonds rallied as a hedge for the first time this cycle while the Fed still hikes in December, the US 10-year near 5.10%, Brent $111, French sovereign stress spilling into Italy, European defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows and breadth in the bottom fifth of three years; sources present 2026-W43): the Swiss index is among those Goldman (19 Oct) names as rallying alongside non-AI and low-beta exposures, which is the rotation this row was set on; the Swiss National Bank was not re-read this week, so last week's 'not hiking' stands. Relative strength is not graded by country. Counter-case unchanged: the franc takes 2 to 3 points a year off a Swiss exporter's reported profit (Sonova memo), and five of the Swiss Pool names are semiconductor names inside an Underweight sector. Back to C if the SNB joins the hikers or the franc reverses.
